question_this_text_answers: How does blocking a necessary input prevent a downstream process?

paragraphs.text: Blocking the courier's route prevents the warning from reaching the outpost. Without the warning, the defenders cannot prepare their response, leaving the outpost unready for the attack.

question_this_text_answers: What investigation will be carried out next?

paragraphs.text: Next year we will compare three courier routes and measure how quickly warnings reach each outpost. This planned investigation will test whether redundant routes improve delivery.
